title: Let the Source Hold the Key: stop explanations from overruling evidence

ciFast.note: Fast verification will confirm the hash-bound source-authority replays, full test suite, build, and bundle gates after the coherent release branch is pushed.

ciDeep.note: This bounded compiler-quality release does not claim a trained adapter, held-out full-course win, paid-reference parity, or new device result.

deploy.note: The release will deploy from the merged main commit after required verification succeeds.

liveProvider.note: The replays use retained source-grounded artifacts and make no fresh provider or model call.

manualHuman.note: No human or instructor judgment is claimed; retained preference evidence comes from one identified Codex judge in two presentation orders.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: The main layered evaluation passes compiler-contract fixtures, the evidence-aware benchmark, and retained production canaries. The release claim remains limited to conservative interception of twenty stable Scion losses with zero model-text mutation; it does not prove that remaining outputs are factually correct or that an adapter beats base Scion.

claims.summary: Across all 46 stable paired-order Scion losses, interception rises from eighteen to twenty while eight answer-index repairs, twelve bounded-regeneration rejects, and zero model-authored text mutations are recorded.

Live Scion kernels require one or two fact citations per MC item, and the absolute-dating and UX-journey-map keys move only from those exact claims under unique question and option support, conservative containment, margin, ambiguity, and negative-claim guards.

Ten retained-source answer repairs use source alignment: eight replace explanation-only inference, two are new, and one former explanation-only repair is blocked because the source confirms the declared key.

The source-authority boundary refuses one newly exposed source/explanation conflict, moving admission from 131 to 130 of 192 atoms and retry burden from 61 to 62 without rewriting the retained response.

Twenty-six stable losses remain unresolved, corpus readiness remains 118 of 464 with 46 of 100 required judge preferences, Gemma weights remain unchanged, and no quality adapter is trained, active, or promoted.
